verdicts.description: Exactly one entry per finding you were given — same ids, no omissions, no extras, no new findings.

id.description: The finding id you were given (F1, F2, …) — copy it verbatim.

verdict.description: CONFIRMED: read the actual code and the finding holds. REFUTED: read the actual code and the finding does not hold (wrong, already guarded, or not reachable).

reasoning.description: One or two sentences citing the actual code (file/line) that justify the verdict.
